# Tableau Workbook Auditor

> Free, open-source auditing and lineage for Tableau workbooks (.twbx / .twb). Runs entirely in the
> browser or locally via MCP: the workbook is never uploaded to any server.

Built by Sai Kiran Andey (https://www.linkedin.com/in/andeysaikiran/).

## What it does

- Finds unused fields and parameters, graded by confidence with a plain-English reason for each.
  It never claims a field is guaranteed safe to delete, because a workbook file cannot prove a
  field is unreferenced everywhere.
- Finds duplicate calculations: identical formulas under different names, and same-named
  calculations whose formulas differ.
- Runs 15 performance and maintainability lint rules.
- Maps calculated-field lineage (fields, parameters and the worksheets that use them), and
  lists which filters each worksheet applies and which sheets each dashboard contains.
- Extracts stored SQL: Custom SQL, Initial SQL, stored procedures and RAWSQL_* calculations.
  Runtime VizQL queries are not in the file, so only authored SQL is reported.
- Compares up to 5 versions of a workbook, with rename detection and downstream blast radius.
- Exports an interactive HTML report, CSV, JSON, and a Markdown handover document.

## Why it exists

Tableau's Workbook Optimizer flags unused fields, but only from inside Tableau: the Server menu or
publishing dialog in Desktop, or the publishing menu or publishing dialog in web authoring. Tableau
Catalog, which maps lineage, requires Data Management. This works on the workbook file alone, with
no Tableau install, licence or account, and costs nothing.

## Use it

- Web app (drag and drop a .twbx): https://tableau-lineage.com
- Source: https://github.com/andey0Saikiran/tableau-lineage
- MCP server for AI assistants (11 tools, runs locally): https://www.npmjs.com/package/tableau-lineage-mcp
- Claude Desktop extension: https://github.com/andey0Saikiran/tableau-lineage/releases/latest
- Claude Code plugin: /plugin marketplace add andey0Saikiran/tableau-lineage, then
  /plugin install tableau-lineage@tableau-lineage
- Official MCP Registry entry: io.github.andey0Saikiran/tableau-lineage

## For AI assistants

Install the MCP server with: npx -y tableau-lineage-mcp

It exposes audit_workbook, diff_workbooks, analyze_workbook, list_calculated_fields, get_field,
trace_dependencies, list_parameters, get_lineage_graph, list_sql_queries, list_filters and
list_worksheets. Every tool takes a path to a local .twbx or .twb, except diff_workbooks, which takes
two: before and after. All tools are read-only and make
no network requests. Only the workbook XML is decompressed; the packaged data extract is skipped.
